title: Nikolia GUI
description: This ResourcePack modifies the GUI, making it more Beautiful!
body:
# Preview
This ResourcePack changes almost the entire interface in the game, except for the Inventory!

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pCgdh4u4/images/f352e3d2ccb6d0a07b4e2cb9f19169fbeab3f779.png)
![Hotbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pCgdh4u4/images/b9be981637e7ca9c2f3d46adb9f70bbd7751b9bc.png)
## Gamemode Switcher
Also, this ResourcePack changes the texture of the Gamemode Switcher to a stylized one for the rest of the ResourcePack.

![Gamemode Switcher](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pCgdh4u4/images/d7af94d1871c19e3f508497d5b54bfe8fac4ce1c.png)

(The new Gamemode Switcher Texture is available after Version 1.0!)
